shared_elements: stylized curled and banded beard and hair
raised arm with open hand holding an object
low-relief figure with profile head and frontal-ish shoulder
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in strict profile with tiered patterned headdresses, minutely banded beards and hair, and an arm raised to hold an object, rendered in the same low-relief convention with fringed garments and stylized floral motifs (rosette band in A, palmette-flowered stalks in B). But A is a horizontal procession of several wingless, interacting attendants above a rosette border, while B is a single large kneeling/striding winged figure grasping plant stalks, so the compositional scheme and the presence of wings differ fundamentally.
